purpose: Determine whether the fixed SQ D1 trades are executable in chronological NFLX M1 data; do not optimize or change the strategy.
audit_rules: Use the 68 already exported SQ trades; no candidate selection.
Use D1 only for signals and ATR levels and M1 only for fill chronology.
A stop entry must be touched by M1 after it becomes active.
For a same-session entry and exit, the exit level must occur after the entry minute.
If stop and target occur in one minute and tick order is unknowable, use the adverse stop-first result.
Market gaps fill at the first observable RTH minute, never at a better synthetic price.
Do not inspect or use any row from 2025 or later.
interpretation: Passing clears execution feasibility only. It does not reverse the previously failed strict all-neighbor drawdown gate.
